name: questvisionstream-v2
description: V2 monorepo root: the com.questvisionstream streaming library (built on the published @realitycollective/service-framework) and the IWSDK Quest WebXR client.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix com.questvisionstream install && npm --prefix quest-client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix com.questvisionstream run build && npm --prefix quest-client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix com.questvisionstream run typecheck && npm --prefix quest-client run typecheck
